This is me
We may think we know ourselves better than anyone else. But is that true? In this unit，
let's explore the idea of self. What do you think of your looks? How much do you know
about yourself? Do you want to challenge yourself? By the end of this unit, you will make
a speech about yourself.
After completing the unit, you will be able to：
• use words and expressions in the unit to talk about yourself.
• use the present perfect tense to talk about experiences of accepting yourself.
• describe yourself and your values.
